scoring_justification: Recompute analytical dispersion from submitted epsilon_inf to verify self-consistency; compare dielectric constants to paper-reported values with tolerance.

outputs.description: Headline DFT-calculated static dielectric constants, analytically computed phonon polariton dispersion, and the relative shift Δk/k, which constitute the main computational evidence for dielectric permittivity modulation as the mechanism of the observed dispersion shift.

output_contract.notes: No gold values or tolerances are disclosed here. The checker will compare the submitted constants and shift against hidden paper-reported gold with appropriate tolerances and will also recompute the analytical dispersion from the submitted ε∞ to verify internal consistency.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold static dielectric constants (pristine and Sn-intercalated), Lorentz oscillator parameters for epsilon_x along [100], flake thickness, substrate permittivity, and tolerances.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported DFT values: pristine (6.7,6.5,4.5), Sn-intercalated (13.3,13.2,4.8). Lorentz parameters from Ref [38] (Álvarez Pérez et al., Adv. Mater. 2020, 1908176): omega_TO=822 cm⁻¹, omega_LO=972 cm⁻¹, gamma=5 cm⁻¹. Flake thickness=120 nm, substrate permittivity=11.7 (Si).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the paper and its cited reference.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact published values needed to recompute the analytical dispersion and to validate dielectric constants.

steps.description: Validate shape, compare dielectric constants to paper-reported values with tolerance, recompute analytical dispersion from submitted epsilon_inf, check self-consistency, and verify shift sign/magnitude.
